note: Primitive drive-in campground in the Paint Creek Unit of Yellow River State Forest, strung for about a kilometre along Little Paint Creek (a stocked trout stream); grassy sites with tables and fire rings. --Claude
summary: Sites 80 -> 74 (73 RV sites 25-80 ft + tent site 118, plus 2 youth-group sites); confirmed non-electric, vault toilets, no drinking water, year-round for sites 60-92 (93-118 close late Nov-Mar 31), 100% reservable on ReserveAmerica, 3-month window, 10 pm cutoff. Fees left as recorded (DNR 2026 sheet, $12/$16). Pin ~610 m off the site centroid. Waterfront lead creekside -> not waterfront.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN (lead, creekside -> not waterfront, by the unsure-downgrade rule): Little Paint Creek is a small trout stream (well under 30 m; not visible as open water anywhere on imagery), so creekside is the right class if any pad earns it. The closest pads to OSM's (coarse) creek line are 097 (15 m), 110 (16 m), 096 (18 m), 113 (22 m), 095 (23 m). Their official ReserveAmerica photos show mowed lawn running back to a continuous strip of tall brush and trees, with no water visible in any of them (088, 095, 096, 097, 110, 113 checked); the creek is under canopy on Esri imagery. With a vegetated screen and no confirmed open bank, the creekside call is unearned. The stored waterfront_evidence is only a pointer to a 2026-06 sweep commit.

PIN (~610 m off): stored 43.18123,-91.23274 sits at the registration booth at the south end. The 74 sites' ReserveAmerica GIS points average 43.18594,-91.23632 (the campground runs ~1.1 km from site 61 at 43.1815,-91.2332 to site 126 at 43.1910,-91.2389).
